parameters.name: BlockInterval
parameters.description: The block duration. Unit: seconds. A value of **0** indicates a permanent block. This parameter is valid only when **OperationType** is set to **block**.

parameters.name: IPList
parameters.description: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks to block or unblock. Separate multiple entries with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

parameters.name: OperationType
parameters.description:
The action to perform. Valid values:

- **block**: Blocks the specified IP addresses.

- **unblock**: Unblocks the specified IP addresses.

parameters.name: UpdateType
parameters.description:
The update type for the block duration. This parameter is valid only when **OperationType** is set to **block**. Valid values:

- **cover**: The new block duration overwrites the existing one.

- **uncover**: The longer of the new and existing block durations is used.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the default value cover is used.
